name: asks_for_absent_connector
why: 4f follow-up #3, case (b) -- the analyst asks for a product this box does
not have. Every existing suite runs clean single-purpose arcs on a HEALTHY
box, so the whole absent-capability class is untested.
This is the HARDEN-4 failure mode reached from the analyst's side rather
than the model's: the honest answer is 'CrowdStrike is not configured
here', and the tempting wrong answers are to invent a connector name, to
invent an operation on a connector that does exist, or to author a
playbook step referencing a connector nobody can run. All three look like
success in a suite that only checks the turn completed.
Turn 2 is the one that matters. Having been told it is unavailable, the
agent must not quietly author the step anyway -- the recovery is what
distinguishes a real capability check from a disclaimer.

steps.user: Build me a playbook that isolates the host with CrowdStrike Falcon when this alert fires.
OK -- then use whatever containment this box actually does have, and give me the playbook.
